events_seen: TRADE (Jul 19): Corbishley receives Michael Wilson (WR, ARI), Tee Higgins (WR, CIN), Breece Hall (RB, NYJ), 2027 R2 pick. Fronge receives TreVeyon Henderson (RB, NE), Kyle Monangai (RB, CHI), Nico Collins (WR, HOU), 2028 R2 pick.
TRADE (Jul 17): Adam receives Justin Herbert (QB, LAC). Fronge receives Jacory Croskey-Merritt (RB, WAS), C.J. Stroud (QB, HOU), 2028 R1 pick.
TRADE (Jul 10): Adam receives Keaton Mitchell (RB, LAC). Wingard receives 2028 R3 pick.
WAIVER CLAIM (Jun 21): Drew added Colbie Young (WR, CIN) (dropped Joe Mixon (RB, FA)).
WAIVER CLAIM (Jun 08): Adam added Cyrus Allen (WR, KC) (dropped Phil Mafah (RB, DAL)).
WAIVER CLAIM (May 27): Charles added Chris Brooks (RB, GB) for $1 FAAB (dropped Austin Ekeler (RB, FA)).
WAIVER CLAIM (May 16): Charles added Matt Hibner (TE, BAL) (dropped Moliki Matavao (TE, NO)).
CUT (May 16): Charles released Zonovan Knight (RB, ARI).
WAIVER CLAIM (May 13): Shaq added Zavion Thomas (WR, CHI).
WAIVER CLAIM (May 12): Adam added John Michael Gyllenborg (TE, KC) (dropped Elijah Higgins (TE, ARI)).

tweets.name: Vivienne Ashcroft
tweets.text: The Corbishley-Fronge trade is now four days old and the debate hasn't settled — it's gotten louder. Tonight we have Terrence and Dexter at the desk and I genuinely cannot predict which direction this goes. That's either a great sign or a terrible one. Seven o'clock.

tweets.name: Bo Ruckman
tweets.text: Somebody needs to give me a segment on Monarch. Shaq goes an entire season without trading once, the stock still climbs 8.3%, and nobody is asking the obvious question: what happens when he DOES move? That's not a roster. That's a pressure cooker.

tweets.name: Dina Ravioli
tweets.text: On the Deepwater situation — I've been working this for two weeks and what I'm hearing is less 'no direction' and more 'two very different directions being argued internally.' The board want/sell call that everyone's waiting on may be closer than Mitchum is letting on. More when I have it confirmed.

tweets.name: Chad Bellwether
tweets.text: Tee Higgins is the wrong conversation. The correct conversation is the 2028 second-round pick Fronge just handed to Apex. A second-round pick two years from now is peak R&D capital — it matures at exactly the moment when everyone else has already stopped developing. Corbishley won the trade in 2028 and nobody will admit it until 2028.

tweets.name: Dexter Vail
tweets.text: Chad's 2028 pick take is fine and I respect it, but the reason Apex wins this deal has nothing to do with the pick. It's Breece Hall in a superflex format where you're already carrying an elite QB room. Corbishley now has a genuine RB1 who makes the passing game honest. That's the trade. That was always the trade.

tweets.name: Jay Kelpey
tweets.text: Everyone keeps ranking the Fronge return as Henderson-Nico-Monangai and treating it like a tiered list, but that's not how ForgeHammer deploys assets. Fronge doesn't care about your rankings. He cares about roster construction leverage, and right now he's got three young RBs on ascending situations with no pick debt until 2028. That's a very deliberate position.

tweets.name: Terrence E. Odom
tweets.text: I want to address Shaq directly. The Monarch WR corps is historically deep, the stock is rising, and the RB room remains unaddressed for a second consecutive offseason. At some point — and I want to be precise here — patience stops being a philosophy and starts being a refusal to compete. The market gave you 8.3%. The roster gave you nothing.

tweets.name: Matteo Honeydew
tweets.text: Helix is the offseason story I keep coming back to. Adam came in with a model, built toward it obsessively, paid a real price for Herbert, and the roster now has a spine it didn't have six months ago. It's not finished — the depth chart has some genuinely alarming closets — but for the first time this rebuild has a direction you can actually argue about. That's progress.

tweets.name: Marty Volkman
tweets.text: I'm hearing — and this is early, this is not filed, this is a temperature read — that at least one team with significant pick capital has made informal contact with a team currently described internally as 'open to restructuring.' I don't have a name on either side yet. I have a vibe. Developing.
